title: Apply for a single status certificate
summary: Find out how to apply for a single status certificate, which verifies that you have not been married in NSW during a specified period of time.
intro:
If you're planning to marry overseas, or if you're returning to your country of residence to get married, you may need a single status certificate. This certificate verifies that you've not been married in NSW during a specified period of time.

You can apply for a single status certificate in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by mail.

Certificates are sent to you by the NSW Registry of Births Deaths & Marriages, using registered post. You cannot get a certificate from a service centre.
who_can_apply: If applying for your own certificate, you need 3 copies of your own identification.
If applying for a certificate on behalf of another person, you need to provide the necessary documentation for that person.
what_you_need: Details for the single status search, including details of any previous marriages.
3 forms of identification as specified on the application.
The PDF form: 'NSW Single Status Certificate Application' (https://www.nsw.gov.au/sites/default/files/2024-11/apply-single-status-certificate.pdf).
The documents provided as proof of identity may be verified through the National Document Verification Service (DVS).
It is suggested that you do not laminate your certificates and that identity documents are kept in their original state where possible.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the NSW Single Status Certificate Application – PDF.
Make sure you have all the required documentation.
Lodge your application with the required documentation and payment using the details on the form.
When the Registry receives your complete and correct application, processing time starts.
The processing time does not include delivery time.

faqs.q: How can I apply for a single status certificate?
faqs.a: You can apply in person at a Service NSW Centre or by mail. The certificate will be sent to you by the NSW Registry of Births Deaths & Marriages using registered post.

faqs.q: Can I get the certificate from a Service NSW Centre?
faqs.a: No, you cannot get a certificate from a service centre; the NSW Registry of Births Deaths & Marriages sends it to you.

faqs.q: What should I do before applying for the certificate?
faqs.a: Check the legal requirements with the consulate, embassy, or local representative of the country in which you wish to marry.
